definitions.explanation: A mythical winged, fire-breathing creature from Western mythology. In Japanese, ドラゴン refers specifically to the Western-style dragon, as distinct from {竜|りゅう} or {龍|りゅう} (the East Asian dragon).

examples.japanese: ドラゴンが{火|ひ}を{吐|は}く。
ドラゴンを{倒|たお}して{姫|ひめ}を{助|たす}ける。
examples.english: Defeat the dragon and rescue the princess.

examples.japanese: このゲームでは{様々|さまざま}な{種類|しゅるい}のドラゴンが{登場|とうじょう}する。
examples.english: Various types of dragons appear in this game.

notes:
USAGE:
ドラゴン refers to Western-style dragons — winged, fire-breathing reptilian creatures. East Asian dragons (long, serpentine, associated with water and weather) are called {竜|りゅう} or {龍|りゅう}. In fantasy games, manga, and anime, ドラゴン is the standard term regardless of dragon type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドラゴンクエスト: Dragon Quest (famous game series)
- ドラゴンボール: Dragon Ball (famous manga/anime)
- ドラゴン{退治|たいじ}: dragon slaying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {竜|りゅう}/{龍|りゅう}: dragon (East Asian style)
